classes.name: ResetPasswordService
classes.description: Service class managing password reset operations such as code generation, email dispatch, validation, and password updates.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and retrieves the EmailService instance used for sending emails.

methods.name: getResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and retrieves the ResetPasswordDao instance used for database operations related to password reset requests.

methods.name: hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Calculates the number of days since the password reset request was made; used to determine expiry.

methods.name: extractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Decodes and extracts metadata (like username) from a reset code.

methods.name: generateEmailBody
methods.description: Generates email content by reading a template file and replacing placeholders.

methods.name: searchForUserRecord
methods.description: Searches for an active, non-terminated user by username.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetEmailBody
methods.description: Creates the email body content with personalized reset link and user info.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the user's work email after validation.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Creates a Base64-encoded reset code containing the identifier and random bytes.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Checks if a user is valid and not terminated.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the reset code URL, ensuring it matches the latest code and is not expired.

methods.name: logPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Logs a password reset request by generating a code, creating a request record, and sending an email.

methods.name: saveResetPassword
methods.description: Saves a new password for the user after validation, within a transaction.
